articles.title: Trial date of alleged Charlie Kirk killer set for June 2028
articles.summary: Tyler Robinson has pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder and six other charges in connection with the 2025 killing of the conservative activist.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Trial date of alleged Charlie Kirk killer set for June 2028
articles.summaryTr: Tyler Robinson has pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder and six other charges in connection with the 2025 killing of the conservative activist.
articles.articleText: Trial date of alleged Charlie Kirk killer set for June 2028 - Published The trial of Tyler Robinson, the man accused of killing conservative activist Charlie Kirk, will start in June 2028, a judge has ordered. Robinson, 23, has pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder and six other charges in connection with the September 2025 killing of Kirk, 31, who was shot while he spoke at a Utah college campus. Utah County judge Tony Graf Jr on Monday told the court that jury selection would begin on 21 June, 2028. The prosecution has estimated the trial could last 17 weeks, while defence lawyers have said it could take seven months. Robinson could face the death penalty if found guilty of aggravated murder, something his defence team has sought to prevent. Prosecutors previously told the court they could be ready for trial by October 2027 but were willing to move that date back to January 2028 to avoid the holiday period. But defence attorneys said they needed more time to prepare their case and floated a 2029 start. As well as trying to stop Robinson facing the death penalty, they have also tried to have cameras banned from the courtroom. Kirk's widow, Erika, with whom he had two children, had pushed for as early a trial date as possible while also arguing proceedings should be live-streamed. She, along with Kirk's parents, Robert and Kathryn, have attended a number of court hearings in the case. At the end of Monday's proceedings, Erica Kirk's lawyer, Jeffrey A Nieman, told the judge that while "a trial in the summer of 2028, three years after Charlie's assassination, does not feel very speedy to the Kirk family", they had "no choice but obviously to accept the schedule the court's put forward". Nieman added: "The family has waited long enough already; they should not have to wait any longer for this." During a five-day preliminary hearing in July, prosecutors outlined their evidence to show probable cause for trial. This included DNA allegedly tying Robinson to the murder weapon and other items recovered at the scene; confessions he allegedly made to loved ones; and a taped video statement from his roommate and romantic partner, Lance Twiggs. "There is a mountain of evidence that proves that he is the shooter," prosecutor Ryan McBride told the court in September. "We know that the defendant is the shooter… first, because of the video evidence; second, because of the DNA; third, because of his admissions; and fourth, because of circumstantial evidence," McBride said. Defence attorneys, meanwhile, have cast doubt upon evidence and expert witness credentials in the case.

articles.titleTr: CEO hakkındaki soruşturma yatırımcıyı kaçırdı: Nvidia hisselerinde yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüş!
articles.summaryTr: Nvidia hisseleri, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin iddialar sonrası başlatılan bağımsız soruşturmanın etkisiyle yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüşle açıldı. Hisseler daha sonra 175,9 dolara kadar geriledi.
articles.articleText: CEO hakkındaki soruşturma yatırımcıyı kaçırdı: Nvidia hisselerinde yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüş! - Nvidia hisseleri, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin iddialar sonrası başlatılan bağımsız soruşturmanın etkisiyle yüzde 7'yi aşan düşüşle açıldı. Hisseler daha sonra 175,9 dolara kadar geriledi. ABD'li çip üreticisi Nvidia'nın hisseleri, şirketin kurucusu ve CEO'su Jensen Huang hakkında gündeme gelen iddiaların ardından sert satış baskısıyla karşılaştı. Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu'nun bağımsız soruşturma başlatma kararı, yatırımcıların şirket yönetimine ilişkin endişelerini artırdı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Hisseler haftanın ilk işlem gününe yüzde 7'nin üzerinde kayıpla başladı. Türkiye saatiyle 19.30 itibarıyla Nvidia hisseleri yüzde 5'in üzerinde düşüşle 175,9 dolardan işlem gördü. Alice Huang hakkındaki iddialar soruşturmayı tetikledi ABD ile Çin arasında yapay zeka alanındaki küresel liderlik rekabeti sürerken, Jensen Huang'ın Çinli iş insanı Alice Huang ile yakın ilişkisi bulunduğu ve Alice Huang'ın Pekin yönetimine bilgi aktardığı yönündeki iddialar gündeme geldi. The New York Times'ta yayımlanan haberde, Jensen Huang'a yakın olduğu belirtilen Çinli iş kadını Alice Huang'ın Pekin yönetimine istihbarat amacıyla bilgi aktardığı öne sürüldü. Bu iddiaların ardından Nvidia Yönetim Kurulu, CEO Jensen Huang'ın yabancı istihbarat faaliyetinin hedefi olduğuna ilişkin haberleri incelemek üzere bağımsız soruşturma başlatacağını duyurdu. Huang soruşturmayla işbirliği yapacak Jensen Huang, çalışanlarına gönderdiği mesajda eşiyle ilişkisi konusunda sadık kalmadığını kabul ederken, yönetim kurulunun başlattığı bağımsız soruşturmayı desteklediğini açıkladı. Soruşturma sürecinde tam işbirliği yapacağını belirten Huang, "Nvidia'yı korumaya ve ABD'nin ulusal güvenliğini desteklemeye kararlıyım" ifadelerini kullandı. Soruşturmanın sonuçları ve Huang'ın CEO olarak görevine devam edip etmeyeceğine ilişkin belirsizlikler, yatırımcıların odağında bulunuyor.

articles.title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
articles.summary: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

articles.titleTr: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
articles.summaryTr: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.
articles.articleText: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains? Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax. In part one of our special on how to avoid Australia’s massive hike in capital gains taxes on crypto in July next year, we looked at borrowing against your Bitcoin or setting up a self-managed super fund (SMSF), among four ways to mitigate the impact of the taxes. While an SMSF offers Australians the greatest tax advantages, it’s only suitable for older investors, or those who are willing to lock up their crypto for decades until they retire. For younger investors, moving overseas could reduce your future crypto tax bills to 0% — but there are less drastic options to save on tax too. 5. Leave Australia and move to country with 0% CGT Australia’s impending tax changes have already inspired crypto king Fred Schebesta, founder of Finder.com, to become a tax exile in Singapore. From July, the top rate on real, long-term crypto gains will increase to 47%, minus the effects of inflation on the cost basis. For upwardly mobile, single crypto investors, the “nuclear option” of leaving the country to avoid giving almost half their gains to the government will look increasingly attractive. Many of the world’s top crypto hubs — Singapore, Portugal, Malta, UAE and Hong Kong — offer 0% capital gains taxes on long-term crypto gains in an attempt to attract wealthy investors. Also read: The one thing these 6 global crypto hubs all have in common...Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains? Ben Simpson, founder of crypto advisory service Collective Shift, says some of his members have already pulled the trigger. “Yeah, we’ve had a number of people that have sort of packed up and gone basically, ‘f—- this. I’m off to the Bahamas or whatnot,’” he says. Andrea Yuen, CEO of Sywftx, says she is keenly aware of the tax advantages of living outside of Australia. “I lived in Singapore for 30 years. I do miss my no capital gains tax,” she says. But she didn’t move there for tax reasons, and cautions that uprooting your life to avoid a bit of tax is a pretty drastic step. “I would never say that we should structure our lives only to think about tax outcomes,” she says. “There are many other wonderful reasons why I’ve come back to Australia and continued to live in Australia.” “I think if you’re moving countries solely based on a decision about whether you know your crypto is going to get taxed, then you probably need to think a little bit harder.” Simpson has considered the idea, given he already spends half the year in America looking after Collective Shift US, but looking into the rules put him off. “You really have to cut pretty much all ties to Australia. So if you are genuinely happy to leave and don’t want to come back for the majority of the year, and cut your healthcare and cut all your ties back to Australia, then that is a strategy.” “Bitcoin Jesus” Roger Ver gave up his US residency in 2014, and ten years later he was arrested and charged over failing to correctly report the value of his crypto holdings and paying exit taxes. He was forced to pay almost $50 million to make the case go away. Similarly, Australians leaving the country face a hefty exit tax on departure, which may require selling a decent amount of your stack. “They tax you on the way out. If you’ve got a lot of gains or profits you’re sitting on, they’ll catch you when you leave,” says Adrian Forza, director of Crypto Tax Australia. “Arguably it’d be bigger in the future, but it’s still difficult to stomach selling off everything to leave.” Forza explains you also have the option of paying the Australian taxes later on, but on the full value of the gain after you sell the asset. So if you expect Bitcoin to go up, you’d be best off paying the exit tax now. Related: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework 6. Set up a company to benefit from the company tax rate Simpson is only 27 and the prospect of locking up his crypto portfolio for forty years holds little appeal. Instead, he trades and holds crypto via a company to benefit from the 25% company tax rate. Running a single-person company is easier than you might think, but not worth the hassle unless you have a reasonable amount of capital and intend to make a lot of trades. It requires registering the company with ASIC and paying an annual fee, paying an accountant to produce financial statements and/or an annual company tax return and mucking about with payroll software and payday superannuation contributions if you plan to pay yourself an income. You can pay yourself a dividend at any time when you need some money. “The company structure is good if you’re wanting to cap the capital gains tax at the company tax rate,” he says, but notes there’s a big catch: when you take funds out of the company, you need to pay the difference between the 25% company tax rate and your personal tax rate. “You still need to pay your marginal income tax rates. If you’re on the top tax rate, like 47%,” he says. You may be wondering: if you have to pay your income tax rate anyway, which will equal the CGT rate from July, what is the benefit in paying a few thousand dollars and filling out a bunch of paperwork to run a company? Simpson explains that the key advantage is that while you are building up your crypto portfolio by trading in and out of different coins, you only pay the 25% company rate for each sale. That means paying up to 22% less than CGT each time you exit a position, which builds into an even more significant saving over time. “Instead of paying 47% because you’ve just taken the profits… then the CGT amount is only 25% — the company tax rate. So when you put that money back in, you’ve got more capital to play with.” However, if you don’t trade enough, it might be taxed at 30%. Forza says the advantages are greater for those on higher incomes. “If you’re a single person, then you’ve got a company, and you’re earning, you know, 150 grand a year, um, or over 200, then yeah, definitely a company would be the way to go, especially now that the CGT discount has gone out the window.” It’s not a particularly useful structure if you just plan to just hold your Bitcoin, however. There are some potential advantages but arguably not enough of them to be worth the hassle. 7. Just get out of crypto entirely to avoid high CGT rates The 50% CGT discount has been replaced by an indexation discount, which takes into account how much inflation affects how much you paid originally for an asset. This means that investors who buy and hold dividend stocks or index funds for a long period will receive a bigger CGT discount. So should you drop crypto and buy a bunch of ETFs so you can pay less tax? The short answer is no: the new CGT ‘discount’ is largely an illusion, as it simply measures your real gain after inflation. Simpson says crypto has been hit hard by the CGT changes, but it still offers the best risk-reward opportunity. “For us in Bitcoin, the growth ... heavily outweighs the tax considerations. In my point of view. If you’ve got the right portfolio, that can give you the right upside.” History suggests that despite volatility and years-long bear markets, the return from investing in Bitcoin over time would still leave investors ahead of ETF investors even after paying more tax. Investing further down the risk curve with altcoins however, can either pay off handsomely or end in total disaster. JPMorgan assumes that Bitcoin will compound by 10% on average in the years ahead. (Source JPMorgan/Bitcoin Archive) Simpson says he convinced his younger sister, who is a basketball player on a low income, to invest in Bitcoin two years ago rather than putting money into a savings account. “She’s up like 40% or 50% in her portfolio and she’s like, ‘wow, this is going to get me so much further towards buying a house one day than sitting in cash and losing 10% [to inflation over time],” he says. “That’s why I think Bitcoin makes so much sense to accumulate. And the tax considerations are not really there for most people I think.” Yuen says crypto is one of the few asset classes that offers investors the chance to make double-digit returns in a few months, or to potentially double their money. Even after paying the new taxes, crypto investors with those sorts of returns will still be ahead. “My dad always said to me, it’s a good thing, if you’ve made profits, you should be happy to pay some tax on it.” Well maybe not happy about it, but you’ll still be making money. articles.title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
articles.summary: Eyewitnesses say the explosion shook the ground, with one believing an earthquake had hit near the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga.

articles.titleTr: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
articles.summaryTr: Eyewitnesses say the explosion shook the ground, with one believing an earthquake had hit near the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga.
articles.articleText: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people - Published At least 17 people have died and 12 others have been injured in an explosion at an iron and steel factory near the port city of Izmir in western Turkey. All those killed and injured were workers at the Habas Demir Celik plant in Aliaga, one of the country's leading steel producers, authorities said. Footage from the scene showed a large fire inside the facility and a towering column of smoke rising into the air. The local governor said the blast happened around midday after a crane carrying a replacement boiler collapsed, causing materials to fall into a furnace below. Workplace accidents remain a chronic problem in Turkey, the Turkish Health and Safety Labor Watch, an independent civil society organisation, said. President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan originally said the death toll was 16, but the Health Minister, Kemal Memişoğlu, later announced that one of those who had been critically injured had later died, taking the toll to 17. Eyewitnesses at the scene said the explosion shook the ground, with one person initially believing an earthquake had struck. In a statement, the company that runs the factory said the accident occurred during scheduled maintenance work on one of the plant's electric arc furnaces. Izmir Governor Süleyman Elban told media that some people were believed to still be under the rubble. Speaking after a cabinet meeting on Monday, Erdoğan confirmed the deaths and said investigations were under way, while search and rescue operations continued. At least five people have been arrested, according BBC News's Turkish service, citing local media reports. The Habas plant is in the Izmir district of Aliaga which is a major port and one of Turkey's main shipbreaking hubs. - Published29 October - Published15 October

articles.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.summary: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
articles.summaryTr: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.
articles.articleText: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets. North Korean hackers created memecoins to launder cryptocurrency stolen in the $6.3 billion Binance hack, routing roughly $430,000 through six newly launched tokens on the NEAR blockchain, according to a report from blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. Between Nov. 5 and 7, the hackers created at least six tokens on NEAR and used liquidity pools on decentralized exchanges to move stolen funds between wallets, Elliptic said. The tokens attracted almost no outside trading and were abandoned shortly after launch. The hackers used one set of wallets to swap stolen NEAR tokens for the new memecoins, then used another set to sell those memecoins back into the pools for NEAR. The swaps let them move funds without direct wallet-to-wallet transfers, though the transactions remained traceable onchain. How stolen NEAR moved between wallets through liquidity pools. Source: Elliptic Elliptic also found that five of the six token creators were funded with proceeds from earlier token sales just two to 13 minutes before the next launch, linking the tokens in a chain of transactions. “North Korea’s launderers rarely rely on a single technique,” Elliptic co-founder Tom Robinson wrote in the report. “Instead, they layer many cheap techniques, each adding a little more delay.” Elliptic said the same laundering technique was also used following the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, when North Korean-linked actors moved at least $24 million through a newly created token on the TRON blockchain. At the time of Elliptic’s analysis, about 11.8 million NEAR stolen in the Binance hack remained unmoved. Elliptic valued those funds at $43.7 million. articles.title: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
articles.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

articles.titleTr: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
articles.summaryTr: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.
articles.articleText: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027. Formation Securities, a newly established company licensing technology from decentralized exchange Orca, has notified the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) of plans to launch a tokenized stock trading venue on Solana in early 2027. The company said Monday that tokenized shares of Galaxy Digital, Exodus Movement and Forward Industries are expected to be available at launch. The venue would operate under the SEC’s temporary Innovation Exemption announced in September, which allows verified investors to trade certain US-listed shares around the clock while retaining voting, dividend and other shareholder rights. Superstate and Securitize are expected to make tokenized shares available on the marketplace, which Formation says it intends to develop in cooperation with public companies. The venue would use automated market maker (AMM) technology, allowing investors to hold securities in their own wallets and settle trades onchain against stablecoins and other eligible assets. Traditional transfer agents would continue to maintain official shareholder records, preserving companies’ direct relationships with shareholders. Solana is already among the largest blockchains for tokenized equities, with approximately $575 million in tokenized stock value as of Monday, compared with $747 million on Ethereum and $1.7 billion on BNB Chain, according to RWA.xyz data. Related: Robinhood’s Tenev warns US tokenization uncertainty deters ‘serious assets’ Tokenized stock plans draw issuer concerns Formation’s issuer-focused approach comes amid growing debate over how publicly traded shares should be brought onchain. As of early November, more than 50 companies had objected to having their shares tokenized on OKXICE, a proposed venue backed by crypto exchange OKX and New York Stock Exchange parent Intercontinental Exchange. Under the SEC’s Innovation Exemption, trading venues must notify issuers in writing and wait at least 30 calendar days before trading shares tokenized by unaffiliated third parties, giving companies an opportunity to object. Nasdaq warned in September that tokenized stock trading could have unforeseen consequences for liquidity, price discovery and long-term shareholder value. articles.titleTr: TR Anadolu Metal'in (TRMET) 9 aylık kârı yüzde 39 geriledi! İşte 3. çeyrek bilançosu
articles.summaryTr: TR Anadolu Metal, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 778,9 milyon TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin çeyreklik kârı, iki kurumun 656,5 milyon TL'lik ortalama beklentisinin üzerinde gerçekleşti. Dokuz aylık net kâr ise yıllık yüzde 39 azaldı.
articles.articleText: TR Anadolu Metal'in (TRMET) 9 aylık kârı yüzde 39 geriledi! İşte 3. çeyrek bilançosu - TR Anadolu Metal, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 778,9 milyon TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin çeyreklik kârı, iki kurumun 656,5 milyon TL'lik ortalama beklentisinin üzerinde gerçekleşti. Dokuz aylık net kâr ise yıllık yüzde 39 azaldı. TR Anadolu Metal Madencilik İşletmeleri A.Ş. (TRMET), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, yılın üçüncü çeyreğinde 778 milyon 872 bin TL net kâr elde etti. Matriks Haber tarafından düzenlenen bilanço anketine katılan iki kurumun ortalama net kâr beklentisi 656 milyon 500 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Böylece TRMET'in açıkladığı kâr, ortalama beklentiyi yaklaşık yüzde 19 aştı. 9 aylık net kâr yüzde 39 azaldı TR Anadolu Metal, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde toplam 2 milyar 15 milyon 127 bin TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki net kârı 3 milyar 291 milyon 456 bin TL olmuştu. Böylece dokuz aylık net kâr yıllık bazda yüzde 39 geriledi. Şirketin satış gelirleri ise aynı dönemde yüzde 32 artarak 24 milyar 28 milyon 682 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Geçen yılın ilk dokuz ayında satışlar 18 milyar 166 milyon 341 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Esas faaliyet kârı 3 milyar 848 milyon 416 bin TL'den 6 milyar 526 milyon 427 bin TL'ye, FAVÖK ise 4 milyar 952 milyon 975 bin TL'den 9 milyar 916 milyon 118 bin TL'ye çıktı. Varlıklar ve borçlar yükseldi 30 Eylül 2026 itibarıyla şirketin toplam varlıkları 70 milyar 708 milyon 882 bin TL olarak kaydedildi. 2025 yıl sonunda toplam varlıklar 64 milyar 174 milyon 435 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Toplam borçlar 6 milyar 844 milyon 474 bin TL'den 12 milyar 169 milyon 506 bin TL'ye yükselirken, özkaynaklar 30 milyar 491 milyon 759 bin TL'den 30 milyar 827 milyon 467 bin TL'ye çıktı. Şirketin özkaynakları çeyreklik dönemde yüzde 3 azaldı. TRMET hisse çarpanları TR Anadolu Metal'in piyasa değeri 44,97 milyar TL olarak açıklanırken, fiyat/kazanç (F/K) oranı 39,12, piyasa değeri/defter değeri (PD/DD) oranı ise 1,46 seviyesinde bulunuyor.

Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketler, 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını açıklamayı sürdürüyor. 9 Kasım Pazartesi günü çok sayıda şirketin Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) bildirdiği bilançolarda hem güçlü kâr artışları hem de dikkat çeken zararlar öne çıktı. Borsada 140'ı aşkın şirketten bilanço yağmuru Borsa İstanbul'da 140'ı aşkın şirket, 2026 yılının 9 aylık finansal sonuçlarını açıkladı. Bilançolarda bazı şirketler kârını katlarken, bazıları zarara geçti. İşte şirketlerin geçen yılın aynı dönemiyle karşılaştırmalı kâr ve zarar rakamları... Borsa İstanbul'da işlem gören şirketler, 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını açıklamayı sürdürüyor. 9 Kasım Pazartesi günü çok sayıda şirketin Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) bildirdiği bilançolarda hem güçlü kâr artışları hem de dikkat çeken zararlar öne çıktı. Bazı şirketler geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki zararlarını kâra dönüştürürken, bazı şirketlerin net kârında gerileme yaşandı. Özellikle sanayi, enerji, teknoloji, gayrimenkul ve holding sektörlerinde açıklanan finansal sonuçlar yatırımcıların gündeminde yer aldı. Şirketlerin 2026 yılının ilk dokuz ayına ilişkin net dönem kârları ve zararları, 2025 yılının aynı dönemiyle karşılaştırmalı olarak açıklandı. articles.articleText: Türk Altın'ın (TRALT) 3. çeyrek kârı beklentileri neredeyse ikiye katladı! İşte detaylar - Türk Altın İşletmeleri, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 2,49 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin çeyreklik kârı, 8 aracı kurumun 1,30 milyar TL'lik ortalama beklentisini yüzde 91 aştı. Türk Altın İşletmeleri A.Ş. (TRALT), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) açıkladı. Eski unvanıyla Koza Altın İşletmeleri olarak bilinen şirket, yılın üçüncü çeyreğinde 2 milyar 490 milyon 253 bin TL net kâr elde etti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketin üçüncü çeyrek kârı, analist beklentilerinin oldukça üzerinde gerçekleşti. Matriks Haber tarafından düzenlenen bilanço anketine katılan 8 kurumun ortalama net kâr tahmini 1 milyar 303 milyon 200 bin TL, medyan beklentisi ise 1 milyar 254 milyon 400 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Böylece TRALT, ortalama beklentiyi yaklaşık yüzde 91 oranında aştı. 9 aylık net kâr yüzde 7 geriledi Türk Altın İşletmeleri, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde toplam 5 milyar 482 milyon 827 bin TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki net kârı 5 milyar 922 milyon 218 bin TL olmuştu. Buna göre 9 aylık net kâr yıllık bazda yüzde 7 azaldı. Şirketin satış gelirleri ise aynı dönemde yüzde 35 artışla 23 milyar 432 milyon 408 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Geçen yılın ilk 9 ayında satışlar 17 milyar 325 milyon 5 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Esas faaliyet kârı 3 milyar 922 milyon 648 bin TL'den 6 milyar 745 milyon 92 bin TL'ye çıkarken, FAVÖK 4 milyar 849 milyon 977 bin TL'den 10 milyar 74 milyon 752 bin TL'ye yükseldi. Varlıklar ve borçlarda artış 30 Eylül 2026 itibarıyla şirketin toplam varlıkları 66 milyar 881 milyon 809 bin TL olarak kaydedildi. 2025 yıl sonundaki toplam varlıklar 59 milyar 481 milyon 939 bin TL seviyesindeydi. Toplam borçlar 6 milyar 319 milyon 398 bin TL'den 11 milyar 790 milyon 498 bin TL'ye yükselirken, özkaynaklar 53 milyar 162 milyon 541 bin TL'den 55 milyar 91 milyon 311 bin TL'ye çıktı. Şirketin özkaynakları çeyreklik dönemde yüzde 2 azaldı. TRALT hisse çarpanları Türk Altın İşletmeleri'nin bilanço verilerinin açıklandığı dönemdeki piyasa değeri 128,86 milyar TL olarak belirtildi. Şirketin fiyat/kazanç (F/K) oranı 27,64, piyasa değeri/defter değeri (PD/DD) oranı ise 2,34 seviyesinde bulunuyor.

articles.titleTr: Dev kurumdan bitcoin analizi: Saldırılara rağmen piyasa direnç gösterdi
articles.summaryTr: Binance'e yönelik 6,3 milyar dolarlık siber saldırının ardından Bitcoin'deki düşüş yüzde 6 ile sınırlı kaldı. Fitch Ratings, bu tabloyu kripto piyasasının daha dayanıklı hale geldiğine işaret eden bir gelişme olarak değerlendirdi.
articles.articleText: Dev kurumdan bitcoin analizi: Saldırılara rağmen piyasa direnç gösterdi Binance'e yönelik 6,3 milyar dolarlık siber saldırının ardından Bitcoin'deki düşüş yüzde 6 ile sınırlı kaldı. Fitch Ratings, bu tabloyu kripto piyasasının daha dayanıklı hale geldiğine işaret eden bir gelişme olarak değerlendirdi. Binance'e 6,3 milyar dolarlık saldırı 29 Ekim'de başlayan siber saldırıda Binance'ten yaklaşık 6,3 milyar dolar değerinde dijital varlık çalındı. Olay, bugüne kadarki en büyük kripto para hırsızlıklarından biri olarak değerlendirildi. İşlemler geçici olarak durduruldu Saldırının ardından Binance, alım satım ve para çekme işlemlerini geçici olarak durdurdu. Para çekme hizmetleri 1 Kasım'da yeniden başlatıldı. Bitcoin'de düşüş yüzde 6'da kaldı Saldırıya ilişkin ilk haberlerin ardından Bitcoin, yaklaşık 10 saat içinde yüzde 6 değer kaybetti. Günlük işlem hacmi ise yüzde 67 arttı. Fitch Ratings, fiyat hareketinin geçmişte yaşanan büyük piyasa şoklarına kıyasla sınırlı kaldığına dikkat çekti. Fitch: Piyasa altyapısı daha dayanıklı hale geldi Fitch, kripto para alım satım piyasalarının daha derin ve çeşitlendirilmiş bir yapıya kavuşmasının bu sınırlı tepkinin nedenlerinden biri olduğunu değerlendirdi. Kurum, tek bir borsaya bağımlılığın azalmasının, belirli bir platformda yaşanan aksaklıklara rağmen piyasa likiditesini desteklediğini belirtti. Bitcoin destekli menkul kıymetler için görüş değişmedi Fitch, saldırının tek başına Bitcoin destekli menkul kıymetlere ilişkin analitik değerlendirmesini değiştirmediğini açıkladı. Kurum, daha sınırlı piyasa tepkisinin Bitcoin piyasasının likidite ve altyapı bakımından olgunlaştığına dair kanıtlara katkı sağlayabileceğini, ancak bunun fiyat, işlem hacmi ve piyasa derinliği analizleriyle desteklenmesi gerektiğini vurguladı.

articles.summaryTr: ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Kongre ara seçimlerinde kullanılan elektronik oy makinelerini ve erken oy verme sürecini eleştirdi. Trump, seçim sistemindeki mevcut koşullarda kazanmanın “imkânsız” olduğunu savundu.
articles.articleText: Trump'tan ABD seçim sistemine tepki: “Bu sistemle seçim kazanmak imkansız” - ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Kongre ara seçimlerinde kullanılan elektronik oy makinelerini ve erken oy verme sürecini eleştirdi. Trump, seçim sistemindeki mevcut koşullarda kazanmanın “imkânsız” olduğunu savundu. ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, Truth Social hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda ABD'deki seçim sistemini hedef aldı. Kongre ara seçimleri öncesinde elektronik oy makineleri ve erken oy kullanma süreçlerine yönelik eleştirilerini yineleyen Trump, seçimlerin güvenilirliğini sorguladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Trump, “Bu seçimin dürüst olduğuna gerçekten inanan var mı?” ifadelerini kullanarak elektronik oy makinelerinin seçim sisteminde seçmenden daha önemli hale geldiğini öne sürdü. Trump erken oy kullanma sürecini hedef aldı Seçim öncesinde yayımlanan anket sonuçlarına da değinen Trump, anketlerin bu kadar yanılmış olamayacağını savundu. Erken oy kullanma sürecine ilişkin eleştirilerini sürdüren Trump, bazı toplu oy girişlerinin büyüklüğüne dikkat çekerek, “Erken oy kullanma sürecindeki bazı toplu girişler o kadar büyüktü ki, kaç kişi oy vermeye giderse gitsin, kazanmak imkânsızdı” dedi. Trump, bu açıklamalarıyla ABD'de seçimlerin yürütülme biçimine yönelik itirazlarını yeniden gündeme taşıdı. Trump'ın 2020 seçimlerine ilişkin iddiaları kanıtlanamamıştı Trump, 2020 başkanlık seçimlerinde Demokrat aday Joe Biden'a karşı kaybetmesinin ardından da elektronik oy makinelerini, posta yoluyla oy kullanma yöntemini ve erken oy sürecini eleştirmişti. Trump ve bazı Cumhuriyetçi destekçileri, Dominion Voting Systems gibi şirketlerin geliştirdiği elektronik oylama sistemlerinin manipülasyona açık olduğunu öne sürmüştü. Seçimlerde sistematik hile yapıldığı iddiasıyla Trump ve kampanya ekibi tarafından çok sayıda dava açılmış, ancak bu iddiaları destekleyen somut kanıtlar sunulamadığı gerekçesiyle davaların neredeyse tamamı mahkemeler tarafından reddedilmişti.

articles.titleTr: CW Enerji'nin (CWENE) 9 aylık kârı yüzde 32 geriledi! İşte şirketin 3. çeyrek bilançosu
articles.summaryTr: CW Enerji, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 1,38 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 32 azalırken, üçüncü çeyrekteki net kârı 16,6 milyon TL oldu. Satış gelirleri ise yüzde 6 arttı.
articles.articleText: CW Enerji'nin (CWENE) 9 aylık kârı yüzde 32 geriledi! İşte şirketin 3. çeyrek bilançosu - CW Enerji, 2026'nın ilk 9 ayında 1,38 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Şirketin net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 32 azalırken, üçüncü çeyrekteki net kârı 16,6 milyon TL oldu. Satış gelirleri ise yüzde 6 arttı. CW Enerji Mühendislik Ticaret ve Sanayi A.Ş. (CWENE), 2026 yılı üçüncü çeyrek finansal sonuçlarını 9 Kasım'da Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirket, 1 Ocak-30 Eylül 2026 döneminde 1 milyar 378 milyon 390 bin 123 TL net dönem kârı elde etti. CW Enerji, 2025'in aynı döneminde 2 milyar 21 milyon 404 bin 423 TL net kâr açıklamıştı. Böylece şirketin 9 aylık net kârı yıllık bazda yüzde 32 geriledi. CW Enerji'nin yalnızca 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğindeki net kârı ise 16 milyon 606 bin 485 TL olarak gerçekleşti. Satışlar arttı, esas faaliyet kârı geriledi CW Enerji'nin ilk 9 aylık hasılatı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 13 milyar 685 milyon 302 bin 652 TL'den 14 milyar 485 milyon 481 bin 41 TL'ye yükseldi. Böylece satış gelirlerinde yıllık bazda yaklaşık yüzde 6 artış kaydedildi. Şirketin esas faaliyet kârı ise aynı dönemde 2 milyar 560 milyon 586 bin 411 TL'den 1 milyar 787 milyon 322 bin 707 TL'ye geriledi. Esas faaliyet kârındaki düşüş yüzde 30 oldu. FAVÖK, 2025'in ilk 9 ayında 3 milyar 88 milyon 992 bin TL seviyesindeyken, 2026'nın aynı döneminde 3 milyar 658 milyon 116 bin TL'ye yükseldi. CW Enerji'nin varlıkları 49,2 milyar TL'ye ulaştı Şirketin toplam varlıkları 2025 yıl sonundaki 35 milyar 592 milyon 306 bin 211 TL'den 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreği sonunda 49 milyar 187 milyon 757 bin 436 TL'ye yükseldi. Aynı dönemde toplam borçlar 18 milyar 250 milyon 392 bin 386 TL'den 25 milyar 663 milyon 546 bin 879 TL'ye çıktı. Özkaynaklar ise 17 milyar 341 milyon 913 bin 825 TL'den 23 milyar 524 milyon 210 bin 557 TL'ye ulaştı. CW Enerji'nin fiyat/kazanç (F/K) oranı 9,13, piyasa değeri/defter değeri (PD/DD) oranı 0,82 olarak açıklandı. Şirketin piyasa değeri 19,30 milyar TL seviyesinde bulunuyor.

articles.title: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
articles.summary: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits
articles.summaryTr: The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit.
articles.articleText: PNC Bank tests turning USDC payments into dollar deposits The pilot lets eligible corporate and institutional clients accept USDC on Ethereum, with each token converted to one US dollar before deposit. PNC Bank, the eighth-largest US bank by assets, launched a limited pilot enabling eligible corporate and institutional clients to receive USDC payments through Coinbase. The pilot accepts USDC, a US dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Circle, on Ethereum using Coinbase Payments products. Payments are automatically converted into dollars and deposited into designated PNC accounts, allowing businesses to accept stablecoins without holding them. PNC said the service aims to speed up access to funds and improve cross-border payment efficiency. The bank did not disclose fees, settlement-time benchmarks or the number of participating clients, nor did it respond to Cointelegraph’s request for additional details by publication time. The pilot builds on a partnership established in July 2025, when PNC agreed to offer cryptocurrency services through Coinbase’s infrastructure while providing banking services to the exchange. The partnership led to the launch of Bitcoin (BTC) trading for eligible PNC Private Bank clients in December. PNC’s move follows a similar initiative by Citi, which expanded its Coinbase partnership in September to enable institutional clients to accept stablecoin payments through its Spring by Citi platform, with Coinbase converting the payments into fiat currency. USDC is the second-largest stablecoin by market capitalization, at $70.5 billion, behind Tether’s USDT at $176.8 billion, according to DefiLlama data. The total stablecoin market stood at around $290.8 billion on Monday. Magazine: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest

articles.title: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
articles.summary: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.
articles.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
articles.titleTr: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal
articles.summaryTr: Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform.
articles.articleText: Avalanche’s AVAX leads crypto gains following NYSE tokenization deal Avalanche’s AVAX token rose as much as 10% after the NYSE selected its blockchain to support settlement on a planned tokenized stock trading platform. Avalanche’s AVAX token jumped as much as 10% on Monday, making it the top earner among the 100 largest cryptocurrencies by market capitalization, as the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) announced plans to use its blockchain to settle trades on a new platform for trading tokenized stocks around the clock. AVAX later eased to $8.86, still up over 8% on the day, according to CoinGecko data as of 03:22 p.m. UTC. The token currently has a market cap of around $3.95 billion, with $439.7 million traded over the past day. The Avalanche blockchain boasts a total value locked (TVL) of $633 million, up 4% over the past 24 hours, according to DeFiLlama. “At the NYSE, we’re looking at how blockchain technology can expand what we offer in equities, and we’re picking the right technology for each job,” Dennis Lee, the head of digital issuance at NYSE, said in an announcement. The deal underscores a growing effort by Wall Street firms to use blockchain technology to make stock trading faster and allow investors to trade outside regular market hours. Typically, traditional US stock markets are open from 9:30 am to 4:00 pm EST on weekdays, with trades often taking at least one business day to settle. The NYSE first announced plans for the platform in January. In September, Ava Labs revealed that the exchange had spent about a year testing Avalanche, but the blockchain’s final pick was not confirmed until Monday. Related: Aave launches V4 on Avalanche, laying groundwork for tokenized credit markets NYSE chooses Avalanche Ava Labs said that the NYSE will use Avalanche’s blockchain to keep track of stock trades and help complete transactions on its planned trading platform. The platform will let investors buy and sell digital versions of stocks on different blockchains, while Avalanche will be used to record those trades and make sure transactions are completed. “The upcoming digital trading platform will support equities listed on a range of blockchains, though the ledger that records and settles trades needs to be fast and reliable, let us control who can take part, keep costs predictable, and have a large community of developers behind it. Avalanche meets all those needs,” Lee said. The platform could launch before the end of 2026 if it receives regulatory approval, according to The Wall Street Journal. “Our first conversations with the NYSE team began nearly a year ago, and it’s remarkable how quickly we’ve progressed toward supporting this infrastructure,” John Nahas, chief business officer at Ava Labs told Cointelegraph. “It’s an important step toward blockchain becoming foundational financial infrastructure.” Wall Street dives into tokenized stocks The news comes as other major financial firms are also investing in blockchain technology to make stock trading faster and available around the clock. In September, Nasdaq announced plans to invest $100 million in Kraken’s parent company, Payward, to launch tokenized stocks. The expected launch for that project is the second quarter of 2027. Meanwhile, the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), which helps settle US securities trades, launched a service in October that allows financial firms to turn traditional securities into digital tokens. “Today marks the culmination of years of work to bring tokenized securities into a regulated framework supported by trusted market infrastructure,” Frank La Salla, CEO of DTCC, said at the time. “By extending DTC’s resiliency, governance and operational standards into digital markets, we are establishing the foundation for responsible institutional adoption at scale.” The NYSE deal also follows other financial firms’ efforts to bring traditional financial assets specifically onto Avalanche. In July, Japanese financial technology company Progmat announced it had moved more than 452 billion yen worth of digital securities onto a dedicated Avalanche blockchain. And in September, Aave Labs announced plans to launch a lending service on Avalanche that would let financial firms borrow Tether’s USAT stablecoin using tokenized assets as collateral. Magazine: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest

articles.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

articles.titleTr: CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements
articles.articleText: Release Number 9322-26 CFTC Staff Addresses Use of Trust Companies for Daily Settlements November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission’s Division of Clearing and Risk today issued a no-action letter addressing whether derivatives clearing organizations may use trust companies to conduct daily settlements with clearing members. According to the letter, a derivatives clearing organization may use a trust company for daily settlements if it treats the trust company as it would a settlement bank under applicable CFTC requirements. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
articles.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
articles.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
articles.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
articles.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

articles.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
articles.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-

articles.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.verification: Birincil kaynak
articles.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
articles.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

news.title: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor
news.summary: A woman says an agency boss sent her to photoshoots at the sex offender's Florida beach home.

news.titleTr: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor
news.summaryTr: A woman says an agency boss sent her to photoshoots at the sex offender's Florida beach home.
news.articleText: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor - Published A woman raped by Jeffrey Epstein says the president of the model agency representing her put her in danger, when he sent her to two photoshoots at the convicted sex offender's Florida beach house. At the time, in 2009, Epstein was serving a jail sentence for sex offences against a minor but was allowed to work each day from his home. "My agency's job was to protect me, and they failed. In fact, they put me in danger. And for that, they should be held accountable," she tells the BBC World Service. Roza was 18 when she was first sent to Epstein's Palm Beach home by MC2 Model Management's US branch, having only arrived in the US from Uzbekistan about a month earlier. MC2's US president at the time, Jeff Fuller, now runs another US model agency called The Source Models. "My agency knew exactly where I was. So Jeff knew exactly where I was going," says Roza. She shows us an expense statement suggesting Fuller himself booked her flight home from Palm Beach, following her second shoot at Epstein's home. Fuller has previously claimed he did not know Roza was going to Epstein's house. She says the photoshoots led to her being employed as an assistant to Epstein. Other survivors have explained how the financier used the recruitment of assistants as an elaborate ruse to allow him to continue abusing young women. Roza says Epstein went on to systematically rape her. Fuller has not responded to the BBC's allegations. He has previously said he did not know Roza was being abused. We discovered through the Epstein-related documents released by the US Department of Justice [DOJ] that 10 models from MC2 met, or were in communication with, Epstein after his conviction. The files also show Epstein gave $1m (£742,000) to MC2 in 2005 - despite the agency owners telling a US publication two years later that Epstein had no involvement in their company. Testimony shared with BBC Eye also raises questions about the role played by two other individuals who were active in the model industry, and whom the DOJ files show had close relationships with Epstein - former agent Ramsey Elkholy and agency director Faith Kates. A DOJ statement from last year, that no evidence has been uncovered which would warrant further investigation against "uncharged third parties", is now being challenged by New York State senator, Zellnor Myrie. He has proposed a new sex trafficking bill to give police greater power to investigate Epstein's alleged enablers. Sara Ziff, founder of the Model Alliance, which campaigns for stronger protections for models in the US, approves. "Often, [model agencies] are the problem. They are the link between the model and these predatory men." Roza says the person behind the camera at the photoshoots MC2 sent her to was not a professional photographer, but Epstein's girlfriend at the time, Nadia Marcinko. Roza describes the set-up as "strange - there was no stylist" and the photos were never used. She has since become convinced the shoots were stage-managed by Epstein and MC2. The Model Trap BBC Eye reveals new evidence showing how scouts, agencies and powerful fashion figures helped Jeffrey Epstein gain access to young women after his conviction for sex offences. If you are outside the UK, please watch on YouTube, external An email in the DOJ files, from Fuller to Epstein, makes clear the close ties between the agency and the financier. "Had it not been for you, we would have fired her months ago," Fuller writes of another model in March 2012. "And I would be careful as she blabs about things," he says. A month after Epstein's second arrest in 2019, MC2's US branch was dissolved and Fuller opened a new agency, The Source Models, which is still operating. The BBC has found that 50 models from MC2 were transferred to his new agency. We asked The Source Models to comment on our findings - it did not reply. We spoke to this woman, and she revealed that at her first meeting with Epstein, aged 19, he sexually abused her in his New York townhouse. Ramsey Elkholy told the BBC: "I completely reject any allegation that I knew of or facilitated abuse of any kind… At the time, I had no knowledge of any abuse and I knew only his own [Epstein's] account of his 2008 [legal] case, which I misguidedly believed." He continued: "The record and published reporting show that women were often groomed by other women in his inner circle. I was never part of that circle, or indeed of any such activity… my intention was to help models find professional opportunities by introducing them to an extremely well-connected individual." - If you are in the UK and you have been affected by any of the issues in this story such as sexual abuse and violence, information and support is available at BBC Action Line Lawyer Sigrid McCawley says these female assistants would have had "no choice" in how they conducted themselves. At the time, Kates was the head of Next Management, one of the world's biggest model agencies. She stepped down from that senior executive position in December last year, but is still legally listed as a director of the company. Simona says at this meeting, Kates suggested she undergo plastic surgery and sent details of a surgeon to Epstein. After her meeting with Kates, Simona says Epstein convinced her to stop modelling. And just like Roza, and several other of his victims, she became his assistant. She says he went on to rape her and control every aspect of her life for nearly two years. The DOJ files show Epstein asked Kates to meet an additional five models, though it is not clear how many of these meetings took place. Lawyers for Faith Kates told the BBC: "Jeffrey Epstein was a master manipulator... Ms Kates was one of those grossly misled by Epstein. We approached Next Management for comment, but it did not reply. Myrie told the BBC that if his bill were to become law, and "you were sending models to Epstein and you knew what Epstein was doing, or you should have known what he was doing, you will be held accountable". You know my name. I say, reach out." Additional reporting by Annika Grosser

news.summary: Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are all sending delegation to the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.

news.titleTr: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
news.summaryTr: Kyiv, Washington and Moscow are all sending delegation to the United Arab Emirates for the first trilateral talks since February.
news.articleText: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say - Published Moscow and Kyiv are privately showing "a little bit of flexibility" on the issue of who would controls Ukraine's eastern regions in a postwar scenario, US officials have said. The comments came on the eve of the first trilateral talks aimed at ending the war in Ukraine since February. Senior officials from Moscow, Kyiv and Washington will meet in Abu Dhabi as the fifth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine approaches. Jared Kushner - Donald Trump's son-in-law and part of the US delegation alongside peace envoy Steve Witkoff - said the talks would be focused on addressing the "postwar security concerns" of both Russia and Ukraine. "An important part of this process is encouraging all parties to begin thinking seriously about what comes after the war," Kushner wrote on X. But Moscow and Kyiv's positions on ending the conflict in the first place remain far apart. A key area of disagreement between the two involves Ukraine's eastern region of Donetsk, which is by now mostly occupied by Russia. Moscow has demanded that Ukraine relinquish the parts of Donetsk which it still holds, while Kyiv wants to freeze the contact line to maintain control over those sections, which it says are crucial to its future security. While neither side has budged on these demands, the US official speaking on the eve of the talks suggested that this was just the public stance and that Moscow and Kyiv had shown "a little bit of flexibility, privately". However, he acknowledged that the issue would not be solved without discussions about a new "security architecture". "They will not solve the Donetsk issue and the territorial issue until they know what the security architecture is going to be after the war," the official said. "And keep in mind, we're not going to be able to finalise one without the other." For Ukraine, a post-war "security architecture" may include reassurance that allies will come to its aid if it's attacked again. For Russia, that could be its longstanding ambition to see Nato roll back from eastern Europe – which would be alarming to Europeans. The framework being proposed includes security consultations and crisis communications hotlines, as well as "reciprocal de-escalation measures" between the two. The officials also floated the re-activation of the Nato-Russia Council that has been largely paused since 2022. The last round of trilateral talks, held in Geneva in February, ended without a breakthrough. Soon after, the US-Israel war on Iran diverted Washington's attention from Ukraine, and no other discussions were held since. Since then, European leaders - who have been largely excluded from peace talks – have pushed to be involved in the process amid concerns that decisions about the security of their continent would be made without them. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen urged on Monday to include Nato allies and EU members into any "meaningful discussions about Europe's security architecture". President Volodymyr Zelensky has repeatedly stated Kyiv wanted Europe to be part of the talks. The US official said the Americans would propose moving into a multilateral format bringing the Europeans into the discussion. "Hopefully we'll get the Russians on board," the official said, while acknowledging that "the Russians have a bad taste in their mouth with the Europeans." Since the start of his second term in office, US President Donald Trump – who once boasted he could end the war in Ukraine within a day – has spearheaded several rounds of talks to end the conflict, albeit with little success. Meanwhile, his increasingly conciliatory approach towards Moscow has fuelled deep unease in Kyiv and across the European Union. After meeting Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev in Washington last week, Trump touted a forthcoming "big, beautiful agreement" on Ukraine which "might involve all of Europe". Many in Ukraine are sceptical that this would result into a fair peace. Ukrainian MP Oleksandr Merezhko, head of the foreign affairs parliamentary committee, told the BBC he believes Trump wants "a quick deal at the expense of Ukraine", which will certainly be rejected by Kyiv. The only way to make Putin start real negotiations is by putting greater pressure on Russia through sanctions and deep strikes, Merezhko said. "While Putin has a war machine up and running, he has no incentives to negotiate." He also mentioned recent moves by Trump, such as his deal to buy diesel from Russia, as something that "only encourages Moscow to continue the war". Moscow's delegation in Abu Dhabi will include Kremlin aide Vladimir Medinsky, deputy foreign ministers Sergei Ryabkov and Mikhail Galuzin, spy chief Igor Kostyukov and army general Yury Zhigarlovsky. Kyiv is sending several senior officials who have been part of previous negotiating teams, including Foreign Intelligence Service head Rustem Umerov, Volodymyr Zelensky's chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov, and MP Davyd Arakhamiya. Away from Abu Dhabi, Russia continues to pummel Ukraine with deadly bombardments and strikes on energy infrastructure, viewed in Kyiv as proof Moscow wants to corner Ukraine into accepting a deal on Russia's terms. On Monday, Kushner was cautious to point out that the Abu Dhabi talks could at most "build momentum toward the next phase of negotiations." "This is an extraordinarily difficult and complicated conflict," he wrote on X, adding the US was "approaching these discussions with determination and realism."
